A CELL'S LENGTH BELONGS TO THE PATH
BETWEEN TWO CELLS. The time from one
cell's OUTPUT to the next cell's
OUTPUT depends on WHICH CELL IS NEXT,
because the dispatch that selects the
next cell's code is only partly
executed on each path. So the eleven
NOPs above exist only to make some
OTHER cell come out at 1920. Measured
